entry.title: New: dsh-diorama
entry.summary: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled). Exact install spec: dsh-diorama. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
